core_obligations: Take a surjective etale cover U -> X of finite type over the base; X Jacobson.
The point x of X over the base lifts to a point u of U of finite type over the base.
The scheme case gives a closed point u' of U of finite type specializing u' -> u; its image x' is closed in X (etale surjective images of closed points), of finite type, and specializes to x.
proof_roadmap: Cover; lift of finite type; scheme-case specialization; image closedness.
difficulty_reason: A four-step lift argument; the closedness of the image is the substance.
